thread:
Alex C: ACME support escalation — customer seeing intermittent 502/504s from hosted API (ingress). Started ~08:23 PDT, affects generate endpoints. They report high error rate for a ~10m window and severe client retries. They sent a few sample request IDs.

Mira P: OK can you paste one request id and any error text they saw? also which region?

Alex C: req_id=01H2Z7ABCD9XQK3Y0FQ2T0V0 region=us-west-2. Customer says gateway returns 502 with body: `"upstream error"` and sometimes 504 after ~30s. They said this started after they scaled up traffic (approx +3x) and also after our 08:18 deploy (model pinning change).

Samir R: pinging runtime/ingress. First checks: Envoy logs show `upstream reset` for that req_id. Also saw `x-envoy-upstream-service-time` missing for 502s (means upstream closed).

Ellie (SRE): I pulled metrics — spike in `ingress_nginx_connections_waiting` and `envoy_cluster_inflight_requests` around 08:22-08:30. For a short period our backend inference pods CPU pegged and had long queue length. Looks like backpressure.

Alex C: Customer also shared a curl they used: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hello"}'``` they get HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway, body `{"error":"upstream_error"}`

Mira P: Did the deploy at 08:18 include a model rollout that increases memory/latency? Could be model variant slower causing request pile-up. Samir, any traces linking to a specific model worker?

Samir R: Traces: most failing requests hit `inference-pool-d` and `worker-045`. The worker logs show repeated OOM kill attempts? snippet: ```[2026-03-15T08:22:45Z] worker-045 error: GPU OOM when allocating KV cache, freeing caches and retrying. retry count=3
[2026-03-15T08:22:46Z] worker-045 fatal: upstream closed connection while sending response```

Ellie (SRE): That aligns — autoscaler didn't spin up new workers fast enough; HPA reacted but pods were starting and were not ready for several seconds. Envoy then hit cluster max requests and returned 502/504 as upstream times out.

Alex C: Customer asked for repro steps. I suggested a simple ramp test. We should also give immediate mitigation steps.

Mira P: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) rollback the model pin change in the 08:18 deploy (if that's the culprit), 2) temporarily increase upstream timeouts in ingress/Envoy to avoid 502s for long-running inferences, 3) scale up inference pool (add reserved capacity) while we investigate.

Ellie (SRE): Agree. Quick actions I can take now: increase Envoy `upstream_rq_timeout` from 30s to 60s for the model route, increase `max_conn_age`? and pre-warm two additional workers in pool D. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window.

Samir R: Also adding a temporary circuit breaker tweak: bump `max_requests` and `healthy_threshold` so Envoy doesn't immediately mark all endpoints unhealthy during the scale spike.

support-bot: PagerDuty alert #PD-48712 created: high_502_rate on route /v1/generate in us-west-2 (firing).

Alex C: Logged mitigation steps to the customer. They asked for postmortem and whether this will be billed as downtime. Also asked if auth failures might be related (they saw an occasional 401).

Mira P: For 401s we saw a separate short-lived token validation failure at 08:21 due to a cache miss on auth cache — likely unrelated but will verify. Tell customer we will include auth audit in the postmortem.

Ellie (SRE): Actions taken: rolled back model-pin deploy at 08:34, pre-warmed 2 workers in pool D at 08:36, Envoy timeout increased to 60s at 08:37, circuit breaker thresholds relaxed at 08:38. Error rate dropped to baseline by 08:44.

Samir R: Repro notes for engineering: load test with bursts (3x baseline) while deploying model pin. Steps: 1) run `ab -n 1000 -c 50` against /v1/generate with realistic payloads, 2) watch `envoy_cluster_inflight_requests` and `worker_queue_length`, 3) confirm HPA scale-up latency. Add telemetry for `worker_ready_time` to SLO dashboards.

Alex C: Customer update sent: apologized, mitigation applied, we will follow up with root cause and compensation options. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

Mira P: Next steps: eng-runtime to add backpressure controls (queue caps + shed-to-fallback), improve autoscaler aggressiveness for cold-start worker latency, add an alert for `envoy_cluster_inflight_requests` crossing threshold. Assigning to Samir for RC and Ellie for infra changes.

Samir R: I'll own the runtime fix and instrumenting `worker_ready_time`. Will post RFC by EOD.

Ellie (SRE): I'll own infra changes and dashboards. Will schedule a follow-up postmortem thread and link to this thread.

Alex C: Closing escalation thread with customer for now; creating postmortem ticket and notifying account team. :white_check_mark:
